name: smartspend-root
description: Repository-root runner — `npm run setup` prepares everything, `npm run start` boots FastAPI + the web planner, `npm run mlflow` opens the local tracking UI, `npm run delete` resets generated artifacts. Zero dependencies; the scripts bootstrap mise/pnpm/uv themselves.

scripts.web:check: pnpm -C apps/web lint && pnpm -C apps/web typecheck && pnpm -C apps/web test
